items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: And just before we left for Milwaukee we did “The Tonight Show” with Johnny Carson.

ctx.x: No. You were pregnant. We cleared that apartment out and left for Milwaukee. And just before we left for Milwaukee we did “The Tonight Show” with Johnny Carson. And we drove, with all our junk to Milwaukee and my sister helped us pack and everything. You went ahead with Niki, and we got to Milwaukee and Jackie’s dad had an IGA supermarket. And one day he was short of help. And he said, “listen, one of my guys didn’t show up and a whole bunch of stock came in, could you help me out?” I said sure. So here I am…

My parents had a house at that time. Yeah it was funny. My parents had a house at that time, that was a flat. And our lease was up in Hollis, which was on Long Island.
